Title: New starter cannot access payroll
Description: Our new finance analyst starts today and receives Access Denied when opening the payroll site. Three other finance colleagues can still open it.
AISummary: A new finance analyst is blocked from the payroll site while existing colleagues retain access.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for reporting this. We will review the new starter's payroll-site permissions. Please do not send passwords or authentication codes; the service desk will contact you if more information is needed.

Title: Cracked laptop screen
Description: My laptop screen cracked after it slipped from the docking station. The computer still starts and I can work on an external monitor.
AISummary: A laptop has a cracked screen but remains usable with an external monitor.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for the details. We will assess the laptop repair or replacement options. Please keep using the external monitor only if the device is safe to handle.

Title: Excel add-in missing after update
Description: The Finance Forecast add-in disappeared from Excel after yesterday's Office update. I can use the web version for today's work.
AISummary: A finance Excel add-in is missing after an Office update; a temporary web workaround is available.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the missing Excel add-in and the available workaround. We will check the Office update and add-in configuration and contact you if diagnostic details are required.

Title: Warehouse Wi-Fi unavailable
Description: No handheld scanners or laptops can connect to Wi-Fi in the Berlin warehouse. Shipping labels cannot be processed and dispatch is stopped for the whole site.
AISummary: Wi-Fi is unavailable across the Berlin warehouse and has stopped dispatch operations.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the site-wide Wi-Fi outage and its impact on dispatch. The service desk will treat this as a critical incident and coordinate investigation. Please share any visible access-point error indicators if safe to do so.

Title: Install approved diagramming tool
Description: Please install the approved diagramming application on my replacement laptop before my workshop next Thursday. I can use the browser version until then.
AISummary: An employee requests an approved diagramming application before next Thursday and has a browser workaround.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for the request. We will check the approved software catalog and installation requirements for your replacement laptop. We will contact you if further information is needed.

Title: Teams calls have no microphone
Description: My microphone is not detected in Teams desktop calls, but it works in the Windows Voice Recorder and Teams web. This only affects me.
AISummary: One employee's microphone fails in Teams desktop while working in Windows and Teams web.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for the troubleshooting details. We will review the Teams desktop audio settings and client state. You can use Teams web as a temporary workaround if appropriate.

Title: Shared mailbox access for support rota
Description: I joined the customer support rota today but cannot open support@contoso.example in Outlook. I need it for the afternoon shift; another agent is covering for the next hour.
AISummary: A support-rota member lacks access to the shared mailbox needed for today's shift, with one hour of temporary cover.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for explaining the timing and current cover. We will verify your shared-mailbox access request and authorization. Please do not send credentials; we will contact you if approval information is missing.

Title: Printer makes clicking noise
Description: The third-floor color printer makes a clicking noise and occasionally creases paper. The black-and-white printer nearby is working.
AISummary: A color printer intermittently creases paper and makes noise; another nearby printer is available.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the printer symptoms and available alternative. We will arrange an inspection of the color printer. Please stop using it if you notice heat, smoke, or another safety concern.

Title: VPN disconnects every few minutes
Description: My VPN disconnects every five to ten minutes from home. Two teammates in different locations report the same issue and we cannot reach the internal code repository.
AISummary: Three remote employees have repeated VPN disconnections that block access to the internal code repository.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for reporting the repeated VPN disconnections and affected users. We will investigate the shared network-service impact. Please provide approximate failure times through the approved support channel if requested.

Title: Update distribution list owner
Description: The marketing manager who owned the Events distribution list left last month. Please tell me how to request a new owner; email delivery still works.
AISummary: Marketing needs guidance to replace the owner of a working Events distribution list.
SuggestedReply: Thanks for the request. We will confirm the approved process for changing the distribution-list owner and let you know what authorization is required.
